descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · S05 Existing specs: an add, a delete and an edit made elsewhere reach an open Hospital list, and another physician's patient never does

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 A patient added on the phone appears on the computer in real time, with no refresh or re-entry. (UAT TC-25 step 2; UAT TC-25; TFA-94704 AC 5; TFA-94513 AC 11) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • U5 A patient deleted on the computer disappears from the phone in real time. (UAT TC-25 step 5; UAT TC-25; TFA-94513 AC 18; TFA-94704 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • T2 Edits made on one device (not only add, generate and delete) show on the other in real time, with no refresh. (TFA-94704 AC 5; TFA-94513 AC 11) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Hospital list open in the browser; for 'two open sessions stay in step' a second context from the same storageState sits on the chart; for isolation a second physician owns a patient

When rounding:add, a delete and rounding:update (room 4B-01 -> 7C-14, and 2A-02 -> 9F-09) through the API with the same account; the other physician's patient is looked for on the list and opened by URL

Then Each change shows on the open list without a reload (the new card, the card gone, the new room and not the old one); the other physician's patient is not on the list and its URL does not open it

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions in e2e/reactivity.spec.ts (within Playwright's default 5 s expect timeout) and e2e/isolation.spec.ts. Evidence for the Hospital propagation only: the other 'device' is the same session token (not evidence for T1), the add does not go through the phone's form, Nursing Home is not covered (S01, S02, S09), and the chart context is not asserted after the chan …

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S05 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-25.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 43c38a4f (10-15 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-25/S05

Existing specs: an add, a delete and an edit made elsewhere reach an open Hospital list, and another physician's patient never does

Tickets: TFA-94513 Signing In & Session Security (in progress); TFA-94704 Production Web App Hosting + PWA (development backlog)

Result: passed in matrix/TC-25.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • isolation.spec.ts [chromium] — another physician's patient is absent from the list and unreachable by URL — expected
  • reactivity.spec.ts [chromium] — a change made elsewhere appears without a reload — expected
  • reactivity.spec.ts [chromium] — a patient added elsewhere appears on an open list — expected
  • reactivity.spec.ts [chromium] — two open sessions stay in step — expected
  • reactivity.spec.ts [chromium] — a patient deleted elsewhere leaves the list — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's specs e2e/reactivity.spec.ts and e2e/isolation.spec.ts): fresh @roundai.test accounts (a second physician for isolation) and API writes through e2e/support/backend.ts with the local admin key; dev has no admin key and one shared account, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 202…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
